blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY—Most Rev. Crispin Barrete Varquez, D.D., will be formally installed as the eighth bishop of the Diocese of Tagbilaran on Oct. 27, nearly two decades after he was appointed bishop of Borongan. The canonical possession and solemn installation will be held at 9 a.m. at the St. Joseph the Worker Cathedral Shrine-Parish in Tagbilaran City. The 65-year-old Boholano prelate will succeed as shepherd of the Diocese of Tagbilaran, which was established in 1941. The installation will be presided over by Most Rev.
